questions.text: «the letter which was sent» ni qanday qisqartiramiz?
questions.explanation: Passiv reduced: who/which + was + V3 → V3.

questions.text: «the man who owns the shop» ni qisqartirish mumkinmi?
questions.explanation: has/owns kabi fe'llar bilan reduction ishlamaydi.
first/last/only/next + to + V1 qolipi.
Odam uchun of whom; narsa uchun of which — non-defining, vergul bilan.
Rasmiy qoliplar: the [ot] of which, in which case, by which time.

questions.text: «Walking home, a dog bit me» — bu nega xato?
options: Dangling participle — participle egasi bosh gap egasi bilan mos emas
questions.explanation: It bosh qoida: participle egasi = bosh gap egasi.

questions.text: «Having finished, I left» — bu qanday participle?
questions.explanation: having + V3 — bosh harakatdan oldin sodir bo'lgan.
V3 shakli passiv ma'no beradi: «...qurilgan holda».
Not knowing what to do, he waited.

questions.text: «generally speaking, considering, given» qanday xususiyatga ega?
questions.explanation: judging by ham shu guruhga kiradi.
to have done — perfekt infinitiv; having been done — perfekt passiv gerund.
Bare infinitive: make/let + sb + V1, modallar, would rather, why not, help.

questions.text: «I want that you go» — bu nega xato?
options: want + sb + TO + V1: I want you to go
questions.explanation: want/expect/ask/tell/advise + sb + to V1 — «that» ishlatilmaydi.

questions.text: «regret to inform» va «regret informing» qanday farqlanadi?
options: to — hozir aytishdan afsus; -ing — o'tmishda aytganidan afsus
questions.explanation: Ma'no o'zgaradigan fe'llar: remember/forget/stop/try/regret/go on/mean/need.

questions.text: «look forward to» dan keyin nima keladi?
questions.explanation: Bu yerdagi «to» — predlog: look forward TO seeing, good AT cooking.
Mandative subjunctive: that + ega + V1 (asos shakl).

questions.text: «It's vital that she ___ there» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: essential, important, vital, necessary, crucial, imperative + that + V1.
Inkorda ham asos shakl saqlanadi.
Norasmiy variantda esa oddiy: ...that he goes.

questions.text: «be that as it may, come what may» — bular nima?
questions.explanation: so be it, suffice it to say, if need be — qotib qolgan shakllar.
the → a/an → zero — mantiqiy ketma-ketlik.

questions.text: Umumiy ma'no uchun eng tabiiy shakl qaysi?
questions.explanation: Uchalasi grammatik to'g'ri, lekin ko'plik zero eng tabiiy.
the (ko'plik yoki «of»: the USA, the Alps, the Nile) ↔ zero (Japan, Mount Fuji, Lake Como).
Qat'iy iboralar: to bed/school, in hospital, by car, in fact, have lunch.
the news/weather/same/cinema — «the» talab qiluvchi qat'iy iboralar.
a number of + KO'PLIK ↔ the number of + BIRLIK.
fewer people ↔ less time.

questions.text: «most people» va «most of the people» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: «of the» aniq, ma'lum guruhni ko'rsatadi.

options: all — the/my dan OLDIN; whole — the/my dan KEYIN
questions.explanation: all the day ↔ the whole day.

questions.text: «each, every, either, neither» qanday fe'l oladi?
questions.explanation: both, all, most, several, the majority of esa ko'plik fe'l oladi.
advice, information, news, furniture, luggage, equipment, knowledge, research, progress.
news, physics, maths, economics, politics — -s bilan tugasa ham birlik.
The police are investigating — doim ko'plik fe'l.
hair, paper, time, coffee, glass ham ikkala turda keladi.

questions.text: «a piece of advice» nima uchun kerak?
questions.explanation: some advice yoki much information ham to'g'ri.

options: freezing — extreme sifat; absolutely bilan keladi
questions.explanation: gradable → very/quite/fairly; extreme → absolutely/completely/totally/utterly.

questions.text: Qaysi kuchaytirgich har ikkala turda ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: really cold ham, really freezing ham to'g'ri.
quite + gradable = fairly; quite + extreme = completely.
a lovely big old red Italian wooden table.
Ular «juda» ma'nosini o'z ichiga oladi, shuning uchun very olmaydi.
She sang beautifully (M) in the hall (P) last night (T).

options: O'rtada — fe'l oldida, be/aux dan keyin
questions.explanation: I always go ↔ I am always busy ↔ I have always known.

questions.text: «only, even, just» ning o'rni nimaga ta'sir qiladi?
questions.explanation: Only I saw him ≠ I saw only him.
Boshqa tuzoqlar: late ≠ lately; near ≠ nearly.
-ly → more; qisqa ravish → -er (faster); well→better, badly→worse.
